text: { "entries": [ { "name_han": "太清玉炉经", "logic_thesis": "The text proves that the human body is a sealed alchemical furnace whose fire is regulated by breath and intention; true refinement succeeds only when heat is applied in measured cycles rather than by force. External herbs and techniques are secondary to the continuous tempering of jing–qi–shen within this internal crucible.", "logic_chain": "1) Jade furnace = body as closed vessel → 2) Fire = spirit-will regulating breath → 3) Overfire scatters qi, underfire freezes essence → 4) Cyclic warm-nurture produces elixir → 5) Elixir is transformed consciousness, not a physical pill → 6) Therefore cultivation is timed internal heating, not extraction of outer substances.", "logic_practice": "1) Map the Day Master and Fire/Water balance as furnace temperature. 2) In weak-Fire charts, prioritize gentle breath and night practice (文火). 3) In over-Fire charts, cool with Water elements and rest before refining. 4) Use hour pillars (子丑 vs 午未) to schedule 武火/文火 sessions. 5) Treat illnesses or setbacks as furnace leaks—seal leaks before increasing heat.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 周易参同契 which unifies hexagrams with outer–inner alchemy, 太清玉炉经 focuses almost exclusively on the body-as-furnace metaphor and heat control. It is less cosmological and more operational than 悟真篇, which emphasizes lead–mercury pairing over temperature discipline." }, { "name_han": "上清丹元玉经", "logic_thesis": "The text argues that the 丹元 (elixir origin) is an innate spiritual core already present in the heart-center; cultivation does not create it but unveils and stabilizes it. Shangqing practice therefore prioritizes visualization, pure intention, and celestial correspondence over laboratory or sexual alchemy.", "logic_chain": "1) Humans possess 丹元 as innate luminous seed → 2) Turbid emotion and disordered qi veil it → 3) Visualization + correct breath re-aligns with higher heavens → 4) Alignment crystallizes 丹元 into conscious presence → 5) Stabilized 丹元 confers longevity and spirit travel → 6) Goal is revelation of prior nature, not fabrication of new substance.", "logic_practice": "1) Locate Heart/Fire in BaZi as seat of 丹元; protect it from excessive Metal/Water assault. 2) Daily quiet visualization of a luminous pearl in the chest before charts or ritual. 3) Prefer charts with strong 印 (resource) for Shangqing-style inward work. 4) Avoid sexual or harsh alchemical methods when Day Master is already fragile Fire. 5) Use 甲/丙 days for opening practice, 庚/壬 for sealing and rest.", "logic_compare": "Distinct from Zhong-Lü and Complete Reality texts that stress staged jing→qi→shen conversion, this scripture assumes the jewel is already complete. Compared with 黄庭经, it is more theologically Shangqing (celestial hierarchy) and less organ-by-organ physiological." }, { "name_han": "太上说洪恩灵济真君妙经", "logic_thesis": "The scripture demonstrates that cosmic order is restored when devotees repay 'vast grace' (洪恩) through moral conduct and ritual petition to the Lingji True Lords; disaster and illness are framed as failures of gratitude and social harmony, not only as qi imbalance. Salvation is therefore ethical-ritual reciprocity with heaven.", "logic_chain": "1) Heaven bestows unearned grace (洪恩) → 2) Neglect of grace breeds disorder and calamity → 3) Recitation + reform realigns human will with divine justice → 4) Lingji True Lords mediate and clear karmic obstruction → 5) Cleared obstruction restores fortune and health → 6) Thus piety and ethics are causal technologies of destiny repair.", "logic_practice": "1) When BaZi shows heavy 官杀 or sudden 冲克, combine chart remedy with moral amendment and thanksgiving rites. 2) Treat 'bad luck periods' as 恩欠 (debt of grace) to be repaid by charity and filial acts. 3) Schedule recitation on 甲子/庚申 or local temple feast days of the True Lords. 4) Pair 补印 (resource strengthening) with gratitude practice rather than only elemental objects. 5) Use confession of faults before major 大运 transitions.", "logic_compare": "Unlike pure alchemical texts that locate cause inside the body, this jing locates cause in social-moral debt to heaven. It differs from generic 消灾经 by naming specific Lingji True Lords and centering 报恩 as the mechanism, not only mantra power." }, { "name_han": "太上说十一曜大消灾神咒经", "logic_thesis": "The text proves that misfortune is structured by the eleven luminaries (Sun, Moon, Five Planets, Rahu, Ketu, Yuebei, Ziqi) whose malignant rays can be neutralized by mantra and ritual alignment. Destiny is not fixed fate but a field of stellar influences that respond to correctly timed sonic and liturgical intervention.", "logic_chain": "1) Eleven luminaries govern fortune/disaster → 2) Adverse aspects produce illness, loss, conflict → 3) Divine mantras carry the True Lord's authority → 4) Recitation at proper times redirects stellar qi → 5) Redirected qi dissolves pending disaster → 6) Astrology + liturgy form one causal system of 消灾.", "logic_practice": "1) Map natal BaZi to 十一曜 afflictions (e.g. weak Day Master + harsh 七杀 ~ martial star pressure). 2) On days of afflicted planet (e.g. 土曜/火曜), recite the corresponding curse/mantra section. 3) Combine 安神 with 安星: calm spirit while ritually pacifying the star. 4) Use 太岁 and transit years as primary windows for 消灾 work. 5) After ritual, adjust lifestyle toward the element that balances the attacking luminary.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 太微帝君二十四神回元经 which is body-deity focused, this text is explicitly stellar-disaster oriented. It is closer to Buddhist-Daoist star pacification than to internal alchemy, and more systematic about eleven bodies than simple 北斗消灾 texts." }, { "name_han": "道德真经取善集", "logic_thesis": "This anthology proves that the Daodejing's teaching is best grasped by collecting and comparing the 'good' (善) readings of many masters; truth emerges from critical selection rather than monopoly of one lineage. Moral-political and cultivational meanings of 道/德 are held as mutually illuminating, not exclusive.", "logic_chain": "1) Laozi's words are polyvalent → 2) Single commentaries capture partial angles → 3) Juxtaposing worthy (善) interpretations reveals fuller pattern → 4) Pattern unites self-cultivation and governance → 5) Practitioner chooses fitting reading for context → 6) Wisdom is curated plurality under the criterion of 善.", "logic_practice": "1) When interpreting a difficult BaZi pattern, consult multiple classical rules and keep only those that cohere (取善). 2) Apply 无为 as non-forcing of weak Day Masters—do not over-补. 3) Use 上善若水 logic: prefer soft Water remedies when Metal/Wood clash violently. 4) Study chart as both personal cultivation map and social-role map (德 in the world). 5) Reject technique that 'works' but violates 善 (harmful manipulation of others' destiny).", "logic_compare": "Unlike a single-author commentary (e.g. 王弼注), 取善集 is a florilegium that privileges comparative judgment. It is more philosophical-exegetical than ritual scriptures and more ethically selective than purely technical 河上公 style line-by-line glosses." }, { "name_han": "太上老君说牛王妙经", "logic_thesis": "The text establishes that livestock, agriculture, and human livelihood form one moral-cosmic economy under Laozi and the Ox King; protecting cattle and honoring their spirit prevents famine and epidemic. Compassion toward working animals is therefore a form of cosmic hygiene, not mere folk custom.", "logic_chain": "1) Oxen sustain human food and transport → 2) Abuse breaks the covenant of 生生 → 3) Ox King's wrath manifests as plague and crop failure → 4) Recitation + ethical husbandry restore covenant → 5) Restored covenant stabilizes community qi → 6) Rural prosperity depends on reverence for animal labor spirits.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat 丑 (ox) as a critical storage node—when 丑 is 冲破, attend to digestion, assets, and 'beast of burden' overwork. 2) For clients in farming/logistics, include 牛王 thanksgiving in yearly rites. 3) Use 丑土 days for grounding practice and debt repayment (literal and karmic). 4) Counsel against 'killing the ox that plows' metaphorically: do not burn out the body's work capacity for short gain. 5) Link 土 element cultivation with gratitude for material support systems.", "logic_compare": "Far more agrarian and popular than elite Shangqing or Neidan canons; it sacralizes animal husbandry rather than immortal embryo. Differs from generic 太上感应篇 ethics by focusing on one tutelary function (Ox King) and economic ecology." }, { "name_han": "太上三十六部尊经", "logic_thesis": "The corpus argues that the Daoist canon is architected as thirty-six honored divisions whose completeness mirrors celestial bureaucracy; salvation requires traversing a structured curriculum of scriptures rather than random piety. Hierarchical text-order encodes hierarchical cosmos-order.", "logic_chain": "1) Heaven is ordered in ranks and departments → 2) Scripture corpus mirrors that order in 36 sections → 3) Each section trains a faculty of body/spirit → 4) Sequential or complete reception (受经) confers corresponding authority → 5) Partial or disordered study yields partial protection → 6) Canon structure itself is a soteriological technology.", "logic_practice": "1) Treat BaZi as a 'personal canon': pillars are departments—read them as structured hierarchy, not isolated symbols. 2) Design cultivation curriculum in modules (body / breath / spirit / ethics) analogous to 部. 3) When 印 is strong, prioritize scriptural study path; when 食伤 is strong, prioritize expressive/ritual performance path. 4) Complete a fixed set of core texts before advanced 法术. 5) Use 36 as a symbolic full cycle for 小周天 or yearly review (one theme per xun or per month set).", "logic_compare": "Unlike single-topic scriptures, this is a meta-textual claim about the whole Daozang architecture. It differs from 道藏目录 style cataloguing by asserting salvific power in the number and order of divisions themselves." }, { "name_han": "上清九真中经", "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that nine true (九真) deities dwell in graded body centers and can be visited through sequential meditation; immortality is progressive interior ascent matching Shangqing heavenly ranks. Mapping gods onto anatomy makes the body a ladder of heavens.", "logic_chain": "1) Nine True Ones correspond to nine corporeal stations → 2) Visualization installs/awakens each true god → 3) Each station mastered opens the next rank → 4) Full circuit integrates spirit with Shangqing hierarchy → 5) Integration yields longevity and flight of spirit → 6) Hence graded inner ascent replaces crude longevity drugs.", "logic_practice": "1) Correlate nine stations loosely with BaZi structure (year to hour as outer to inner ranks). 2) Practice one center per lunar month; do not leap ranks. 3) Strong 官杀 charts: emphasize disciplined sequence and ritual purity. 4) Weak 印 charts: lengthen time on each station before advancing. 5) Record dreams/omens after each station as feedback of 真 presence.", "logic_compare": "More systematically multi-deity and ranked than 黄庭's organ poetry; less dual-cultivation than later sexual neidan. It is classic Shangqing: visionary hierarchy first, chemical metaphor second." }, { "name_han": "太上灵宝十部经", "logic_thesis": "Lingbao's ten-section corpus proves that universal salvation (度人) operates through cosmic liturgy, sacred sound, and shared scriptural merit—not elite solitary ascent alone. The ten divisions encode a complete soteriology for self and others in one ritual-scriptural machine.", "logic_chain": "1) All beings share original celestial script/qi → 2) Ritual recitation reactivates that script → 3) Tenfold structure covers creation, judgment, salvation, and return → 4) Merit circulates to ancestors and multitudes → 5) Community ritual multiplies individual power → 6) Therefore Lingbao path is simultaneously personal and collective.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi counseling, balance self-help with ancestral/family luck repair (collective 度人). 2) Use 食伤 (expression) days for recitation and teaching. 3) When 比劫 is heavy, channel into group practice rather than competition. 4) Design ten-module annual practice covering body, speech, mind, ethics, service. 5) Prefer 灵宝-style 斋 for death/transition years over purely personal alchemy.", "logic_compare": "Contrasts with Shangqing elitism and with pure Neidan solitude: Lingbao is liturgical and universalist. Compared with 度人经 alone, the 十部 claim is architectural—completeness of ten as full salvation toolkit." }, { "name_han": "玄天上帝报恩经", "logic_thesis": "The text demonstrates that Xuan Tian Shang Di's martial power to subdue demons is rooted in filial and cosmic 报恩; true spiritual authority is repayment of debt to parents, teachers, and heaven. Exorcistic might without gratitude collapses into mere violence.", "logic_chain": "1) Even the Dark Emperor cultivated under grace of teachers/parents/Dao → 2) Demonic chaos is ingratitude and rebellion writ large → 3) 报恩 rectifies the heart that commands ritual power → 4) Rectified heart + ritual subdues inner and outer demons → 5) Subdued chaos returns order (北帝 justice) → 6) Thus ethics of gratitude is the precondition of martial Daoist efficacy.", "logic_practice": "1) Before 七杀-heavy exorcistic or assertive life moves, perform 报恩 (parents, mentors). 2) In BaZi, when 官杀 is useful, refine it through discipline + gratitude, not raw aggression. 3) Use 壬/癸 and northern sector practices under Xuan Tian for Water-strong charts. 4) Treat chronic 羊刃/七杀 illness patterns as 'unrepaid force'—soften with 印 and filial acts. 5) Annual 报恩 rite at start of 大运 change.", "logic_compare": "Unlike generic Zhenwu exorcism manuals that list talismans and generals, this jing theologically centers 报恩 as the root. It differs from 洪恩灵济真君妙经 by tying gratitude specifically to the northern martial deity's path of demon-subjugation." }, { "name_han": "太上洞玄灵宝天童经", "logic_thesis": "The scripture argues that the Heavenly Lad (天童) force—youthful luminous spirit—can be reawakened by recitation to repel plague, weapons, and evil qi. Spiritual juvenescence is a protective technology: return to pure 童状态 immunizes against corruption.", "logic_chain": "1) Primordial spirit is childlike and luminous → 2) Age, fear, and impurity dim that light → 3) 天童 mantra restores luminous youth of spirit → 4) Restored light repels epidemic and malevolent qi → 5) Protection is radiance, not armor alone → 6) Hence rejuvenation of mind-spirit is civil defense of the body.", "logic_practice": "1) For charts with exhausted 印 or premature aging signs, prioritize 天童-style light recitation at dawn. 2) Pair with Wood/Fire gentle rising practices (肝魂/心神). 3) Use in 病符 and epidemic-fear years as qi hygiene. 4) Visualize inner child-light in the niwan or heart while walking. 5) Avoid cynical over-analysis immediately after practice—protect 童心.", "logic_compare": "More protective-rejuvenative than philosophical Daodejing commentaries; less star-focused than 十一曜经. Among Lingbao texts, it specializes in luminous youth as apotropaic principle rather than full 度人 cosmology." }, { "name_han": "上清天关三图经", "logic_thesis": "The text proves that the 'Heavenly Passes' (天关) are locked gates in body and cosmos that open only via correct diagrams (三图) and sequential passage; without maps, ascent fails even with zeal. Liberation is navigational knowledge as much as virtue or breath.", "logic_chain": "1) Spirit travel/ascent faces guarded passes → 2) Three figures encode routes, guardians, and timing → 3) Meditating the diagrams installs the map in the body → 4) Correct approach opens each 关 → 5) Opened passes allow reunion with higher Zhen → 6) Diagram literacy is soteriological skill.", "logic_practice": "1) Read BaZi 冲刑合害 as 'passes'—plan sequential resolution, not all at once. 2) Draw or study three personal maps: body gates, life phases (大运), and annual obstacles. 3) Strong 食伤: create diagrams and talismanic art as practice. 4) Weak 官杀 structure: need external teacher/map more than self-invention. 5) Before 交运, rehearse the 'next pass' visualization for 49 days.", "logic_compare": "Emphasizes cartographic revelation more than 九真中经's deity installation or Neidan's fire phases. Among Shangqing works, it is distinctive for 图 as primary technology rather than pure verse or pure breath." }, { "name_han": "太上说大帝延寿妙经", "logic_thesis": "The scripture establishes that lifespan is extendable when the Great Emperor's decree is petitioned through pure recitation and moral reform; years are administrative allotments in a celestial bureaucracy that can be revised. Longevity is juridical-grace as well as physiological.", "logic_chain": "1) Destiny boards record allotted lifespan → 2) Sin and waste of jing shorten the register → 3) Confession + 大帝 scripture move celestial officers → 4) Officers amend the life ledger → 5) Amended ledger manifests as health and extra years → 6) Thus 延寿 combines ethics, ritual petition, and conservation of essence.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, weak 印 + strong 劫/伤 may signal short-use of resources—pair conservation with 延寿 recitation. 2) Practice on 甲子 and personal 本命日. 3) Combine with sleep, sexual moderation, and breath as 'not contesting the ledger.' 4) For clients in 衰运, prioritize decree-style prayer over aggressive 补药 alone. 5) Track birthdays as annual audit of the life register.", "logic_compare": "More bureaucratic-celestial than medical 肘后方 or alchemical furnace texts. Differs from generic 消灾 by targeting the life-span register specifically under 大帝 authority rather than broad misfortune." }, { "name_han": "太上说五圣始生真经", "logic_thesis": "The text argues that the Five Saints' nativity discloses how sagehood enters history through patterned birth omens and cosmic timing; sanctity is an emergent alignment of heaven, earth, and human lineage. Studying '始生' reveals the template by which greatness is timed into the world.", "logic_chain": "1) Five Saints appear under specific celestial-human conditions → 2) Those conditions encode a birth pattern of virtue and mandate → 3) Recalling their nativity re-syncs community with that pattern → 4) Sync produces moral renewal and protective grace → 5) Individuals can approximate the pattern in their own natal timing → 6) Hagiographic cosmology becomes a science of auspicious emergence.", "logic_practice": "1) Compare client BaZi to classical 'sage birth' markers (clear 印, useful 官, balanced 调候) without forcing identity. 2) Use 五圣 feast/nativity days for vow renewal. 3) For 日主 weak but 印 strong charts, frame life as 'delayed sage function'—service over status. 4) Study parents/ancestors pillars as the 'womb field' of mandate. 5) Ritual retelling of origin stories as 开运 at career starts.", "logic_compare": "Unlike pure technical nativity manuals (子平), it sacralizes birth as theophany of saints. Unlike abstract 太极 cosmogonies, it narrates concrete holy births as operable templates for devotion and timing." }, { "name_han": "清微神烈秘法", "logic_thesis": "Qingwei method proves that thunder-fire (雷法) efficacy depends on aligning practitioner's heart-fire with celestial thunder bureaux through secret seals, breaths, and commands; outer talismans fail without inner 神烈. Violent weather-spirits obey only a mind already refined to pure decisive clarity.", "logic_chain": "1) Thunder is heaven's punitive/ transformative force → 2) Human heart can mirror thunder if purified → 3) Seals, mudras, and mantras couple heart to thunder officers → 4) Coupled command directs rain, exorcism, healing → 5) Impure intent rebounds as self-harm → 6) Therefore secret method = ethics + precise energetic protocol.", "logic_practice": "1) Only train thunder methods if BaZi can support Fire/Wood authority without mania (watch 伤官见官). 2) Daily 心火 purification before any 符. 3) Use 震/巽 days and hours for practice. 4) Channel 七杀 as ordered thunder, not scattered anger. 5) After rituals, ground with Earth/Water to prevent Fire exhaustion.", "logic_compare": "More martial-operational than Shangqing visionary calm; more lineage-secret than public 消灾 recitation scriptures. Among Lei fa corpora, Qingwei stresses refined heart-fire (神烈) and bureaucratic command over purely shamanic frenzy." }, { "name_han": "洞神八帝妙精經", "logic_thesis": "The scripture demonstrates that eight thearchs (八帝) embody a complete set of cosmic-spiritual essences (妙精); mastering their names, attributes, and invocations reconstitutes the practitioner as a microcosmic pantheon. Dongshen practice is sovereignty through identification with multiple divine wills in order.", "logic_chain": "1) Eight Emperors partition cosmic authority → 2) Each holds a mode of 精 (essence/spirit power) → 3) Correct invocation installs that mode in the adept → 4) Integrated eightfold essence yields 洞神 mastery → 5) Mastery grants protection and spirit efficacy → 6) Polycentric deity work completes what single-god devotion leaves partial.", "logic_practice": "1) Map eight modes onto 八卦/八字 directions for spatial practice. 2) Rotate weekly focus across eight qualities (e.g. severity, mercy, growth, harvest). 3) For missing elemental legs in BaZi, invoke the corresponding Emperor quality as training wheel. 4) Keep a register of dreams under each Emperor. 5) Seal practice by returning authority to the Dao—avoid ego inflation after multi-deity work.", "logic_compare": "Dongshen 'god multiplicity' differs from Taiqing alchemy's furnace unity and Lingbao's universal salvation liturgy. Compared with 九真, eight emperors are more sovereign-administrative than intimate body-true gods of Shangqing." }, { "name_han": "呂祖志", "logic_thesis": "The collected records of Lü Dongbin prove that immortality is a path of repeated testing, teaching, and playful intervention in the world—not withdrawal alone. The perfected person remains an agent of conversion whose biography itself is a didactic logic of trial → awakening → transmission.", "logic_chain": "1) Lü's failures and trials precede mastery → 2) Mastery expresses as compassion and sharp teaching → 3) Stories encode alchemical and ethical laws in narrative form → 4) Reader reenacts the trial pattern internally → 5) Reenactment ripens 剑 (discernment) and 丹 (elixir) → 6) Hagiography is a transmission device equal to technical manuals.", "logic_practice": "1) Use Lü stories as case studies for 食神/伤官 expression in teaching roles. 2) Practice 'one trial, one insight' journaling each week. 3) In weak-will charts, cultivate 呂祖's sword as metaphor for cutting delusion (meditation + decisiveness). 4) Combine drinking/poetry metaphors carefully: spirit of ease without actual dissipation. 5) On 純阳 feast days, renew vows of non-harm and study.", "logic_compare": "Unlike impersonal heavenly scriptures, 呂祖志 is biographical-narrative theology. It is more worldly and pedagogical than early Shangqing ascent texts, and less systematically staged than Zhong-Lü technical dialogues—though overlapping in Complete Reality culture." }, { "name_han": "正一法文經章官品", "logic_thesis": "This Zhengyi text proves that petition slips (章) addressed to correctly ranked officers (官) are the legal mechanism by which heaven corrects illness and injustice; ritual is litigation in the celestial court. Efficacy depends on accurate bureaucracy—right officer, right format, right merit—not vague prayer.", "logic_chain": "1) Cosmos runs as an administrative state → 2) Human affliction often = case pending or misfiled → 3) 上章 files the case to named officers → 4) Officers dispatch functionaries to correct qi/demons/records → 5) Correct filing yields medical-social relief → 6) Priestly expertise is celestial paralegal skill.", "logic_practice": "1) Diagnose which 'department' a BaZi problem belongs to (wealth, health, lawsuits, ancestors). 2) Prefer Zhengyi petition logic for 官杀 and legal-year issues. 3) Write clear intention statements as if filing 章—specificity increases results. 4) Build merit (good deeds) as court 'standing' before major petitions. 5) After ritual, act in the human court/hospital consistently with the filing.", "logic_compare": "Sharply more legal-bureaucratic than Neidan's physiological metaphors or Qingwei thunder commands. Distinct from Lingbao communal zhai by focusing on documentary petitions and officer rosters (官品)." }, { "name_han": "徐仙翰藻", "logic_thesis": "The literary corpus of the Xu immortals shows that refined writing (翰藻) itself is a vehicle of sacred presence; elegant composition, poetry, and revelation texts transmit numinous authority in culture. Cultivation includes mastery of language as talismanic art, not only breath and ritual gesture.", "logic_chain": "1) Xu lineage manifests through inspired writings → 2) Beautiful correct language orders chaotic qi in readers → 3) Literary offering maintains the cult and the gods' responsiveness → 4) Practitioner who polishes word polishes mind → 5) Polished mind becomes fit receptacle for further revelation → 6) Therefore letters are a Daoist technology of presence.", "logic_practice": "1) For 食伤-strong charts, make writing primary cultivation (poems, petitions, journals). 2) Copy scriptures in regular script as 静心. 3) Edit speech: fewer false words = fewer 口业 chart hits. 4) Compose birthday/祭 texts for ancestors as 翰藻 practice. 5) Treat AI/modern writing tools as brushes—intention still leads form.", "logic_compare": "Unlike dry code-law 章官品 or anonymous heavenly dictation style, 徐仙翰藻 foregrounds literary aesthetics of a local immortal cult. It bridges literati culture and Daoist revelation more than purely oral thunder or star mantras." }, { "name_han": "葛仙翁肘後備急方", "logic_thesis": "Ge Hong's emergency formulary proves that true Daoist care includes immediate, practical medicine for crises at hand (肘後); immortality arts without ability to stop acute suffering are incomplete. Knowledge must be portable, tested, and subordinate to saving life in the moment.", "logic_chain": "1) Humans face sudden illness and injury → 2) Complex alchemy is useless in acute emergency → 3) Compact proven formulas enable on-the-spot relief → 4) Relieved body becomes capable of further cultivation → 5) Compassion is demonstrated by efficacy, not rhetoric → 6) Thus medical pragmatism is intrinsic to the Daoist path.", "logic_practice": "1) Separate BaZi long-term pattern work from acute triage—send crises to medicine first. 2) Build a personal 'elbow kit': sleep, herbs/doctor access, emergency contacts, breath-calming. 3) When 疾厄 is activated, prioritize 备急 over metaphysical speculation. 4) Study classical formulas historically while using modern emergency care as the real 肘後. 5) In counseling ethics, refuse to replace clinical help with talismans alone.", "logic_compare": "Radically more empirical and clinical than almost all preceding liturgical and alchemical titles in this list. Differs from 抱朴子's broader immortality theory by being a field manual for urgent prescriptions; spirit and herb cooperate, but the genre is medicine first." } ] }

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the human body is a sealed alchemical furnace whose fire is regulated by breath and intention; true refinement succeeds only when heat is applied in measured cycles rather than by force. External herbs and techniques are secondary to the continuous tempering of jing–qi–shen within this internal crucible.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Jade furnace = body as closed vessel → 2) Fire = spirit-will regulating breath → 3) Overfire scatters qi, underfire freezes essence → 4) Cyclic warm-nurture produces elixir → 5) Elixir is transformed consciousness, not a physical pill → 6) Therefore cultivation is timed internal heating, not extraction of outer substances.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map the Day Master and Fire/Water balance as furnace temperature. 2) In weak-Fire charts, prioritize gentle breath and night practice (文火). 3) In over-Fire charts, cool with Water elements and rest before refining. 4) Use hour pillars (子丑 vs 午未) to schedule 武火/文火 sessions. 5) Treat illnesses or setbacks as furnace leaks—seal leaks before increasing heat.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 周易参同契 which unifies hexagrams with outer–inner alchemy, 太清玉炉经 focuses almost exclusively on the body-as-furnace metaphor and heat control. It is less cosmological and more operational than 悟真篇, which emphasizes lead–mercury pairing over temperature discipline.

entries.logic_thesis: The text argues that the 丹元 (elixir origin) is an innate spiritual core already present in the heart-center; cultivation does not create it but unveils and stabilizes it. Shangqing practice therefore prioritizes visualization, pure intention, and celestial correspondence over laboratory or sexual alchemy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Humans possess 丹元 as innate luminous seed → 2) Turbid emotion and disordered qi veil it → 3) Visualization + correct breath re-aligns with higher heavens → 4) Alignment crystallizes 丹元 into conscious presence → 5) Stabilized 丹元 confers longevity and spirit travel → 6) Goal is revelation of prior nature, not fabrication of new substance.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Locate Heart/Fire in BaZi as seat of 丹元; protect it from excessive Metal/Water assault. 2) Daily quiet visualization of a luminous pearl in the chest before charts or ritual. 3) Prefer charts with strong 印 (resource) for Shangqing-style inward work. 4) Avoid sexual or harsh alchemical methods when Day Master is already fragile Fire. 5) Use 甲/丙 days for opening practice, 庚/壬 for sealing and rest.
entries.logic_compare: Distinct from Zhong-Lü and Complete Reality texts that stress staged jing→qi→shen conversion, this scripture assumes the jewel is already complete. Compared with 黄庭经, it is more theologically Shangqing (celestial hierarchy) and less organ-by-organ physiological.

entries.name_han: 太上说洪恩灵济真君妙经
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture demonstrates that cosmic order is restored when devotees repay 'vast grace' (洪恩) through moral conduct and ritual petition to the Lingji True Lords; disaster and illness are framed as failures of gratitude and social harmony, not only as qi imbalance. Salvation is therefore ethical-ritual reciprocity with heaven.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven bestows unearned grace (洪恩) → 2) Neglect of grace breeds disorder and calamity → 3) Recitation + reform realigns human will with divine justice → 4) Lingji True Lords mediate and clear karmic obstruction → 5) Cleared obstruction restores fortune and health → 6) Thus piety and ethics are causal technologies of destiny repair.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows heavy 官杀 or sudden 冲克, combine chart remedy with moral amendment and thanksgiving rites. 2) Treat 'bad luck periods' as 恩欠 (debt of grace) to be repaid by charity and filial acts. 3) Schedule recitation on 甲子/庚申 or local temple feast days of the True Lords. 4) Pair 补印 (resource strengthening) with gratitude practice rather than only elemental objects. 5) Use confession of faults before major 大运 transitions.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure alchemical texts that locate cause inside the body, this jing locates cause in social-moral debt to heaven. It differs from generic 消灾经 by naming specific Lingji True Lords and centering 报恩 as the mechanism, not only mantra power.

entries.name_han: 太上说十一曜大消灾神咒经
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that misfortune is structured by the eleven luminaries (Sun, Moon, Five Planets, Rahu, Ketu, Yuebei, Ziqi) whose malignant rays can be neutralized by mantra and ritual alignment. Destiny is not fixed fate but a field of stellar influences that respond to correctly timed sonic and liturgical intervention.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Eleven luminaries govern fortune/disaster → 2) Adverse aspects produce illness, loss, conflict → 3) Divine mantras carry the True Lord's authority → 4) Recitation at proper times redirects stellar qi → 5) Redirected qi dissolves pending disaster → 6) Astrology + liturgy form one causal system of 消灾.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map natal BaZi to 十一曜 afflictions (e.g. weak Day Master + harsh 七杀 ~ martial star pressure). 2) On days of afflicted planet (e.g. 土曜/火曜), recite the corresponding curse/mantra section. 3) Combine 安神 with 安星: calm spirit while ritually pacifying the star. 4) Use 太岁 and transit years as primary windows for 消灾 work. 5) After ritual, adjust lifestyle toward the element that balances the attacking luminary.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 太微帝君二十四神回元经 which is body-deity focused, this text is explicitly stellar-disaster oriented. It is closer to Buddhist-Daoist star pacification than to internal alchemy, and more systematic about eleven bodies than simple 北斗消灾 texts.

entries.logic_thesis: This anthology proves that the Daodejing's teaching is best grasped by collecting and comparing the 'good' (善) readings of many masters; truth emerges from critical selection rather than monopoly of one lineage. Moral-political and cultivational meanings of 道/德 are held as mutually illuminating, not exclusive.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Laozi's words are polyvalent → 2) Single commentaries capture partial angles → 3) Juxtaposing worthy (善) interpretations reveals fuller pattern → 4) Pattern unites self-cultivation and governance → 5) Practitioner chooses fitting reading for context → 6) Wisdom is curated plurality under the criterion of 善.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When interpreting a difficult BaZi pattern, consult multiple classical rules and keep only those that cohere (取善). 2) Apply 无为 as non-forcing of weak Day Masters—do not over-补. 3) Use 上善若水 logic: prefer soft Water remedies when Metal/Wood clash violently. 4) Study chart as both personal cultivation map and social-role map (德 in the world). 5) Reject technique that 'works' but violates 善 (harmful manipulation of others' destiny).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike a single-author commentary (e.g. 王弼注), 取善集 is a florilegium that privileges comparative judgment. It is more philosophical-exegetical than ritual scriptures and more ethically selective than purely technical 河上公 style line-by-line glosses.

entries.logic_thesis: The text establishes that livestock, agriculture, and human livelihood form one moral-cosmic economy under Laozi and the Ox King; protecting cattle and honoring their spirit prevents famine and epidemic. Compassion toward working animals is therefore a form of cosmic hygiene, not mere folk custom.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Oxen sustain human food and transport → 2) Abuse breaks the covenant of 生生 → 3) Ox King's wrath manifests as plague and crop failure → 4) Recitation + ethical husbandry restore covenant → 5) Restored covenant stabilizes community qi → 6) Rural prosperity depends on reverence for animal labor spirits.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat 丑 (ox) as a critical storage node—when 丑 is 冲破, attend to digestion, assets, and 'beast of burden' overwork. 2) For clients in farming/logistics, include 牛王 thanksgiving in yearly rites. 3) Use 丑土 days for grounding practice and debt repayment (literal and karmic). 4) Counsel against 'killing the ox that plows' metaphorically: do not burn out the body's work capacity for short gain. 5) Link 土 element cultivation with gratitude for material support systems.
entries.logic_compare: Far more agrarian and popular than elite Shangqing or Neidan canons; it sacralizes animal husbandry rather than immortal embryo. Differs from generic 太上感应篇 ethics by focusing on one tutelary function (Ox King) and economic ecology.

entries.logic_thesis: The corpus argues that the Daoist canon is architected as thirty-six honored divisions whose completeness mirrors celestial bureaucracy; salvation requires traversing a structured curriculum of scriptures rather than random piety. Hierarchical text-order encodes hierarchical cosmos-order.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven is ordered in ranks and departments → 2) Scripture corpus mirrors that order in 36 sections → 3) Each section trains a faculty of body/spirit → 4) Sequential or complete reception (受经) confers corresponding authority → 5) Partial or disordered study yields partial protection → 6) Canon structure itself is a soteriological technology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat BaZi as a 'personal canon': pillars are departments—read them as structured hierarchy, not isolated symbols. 2) Design cultivation curriculum in modules (body / breath / spirit / ethics) analogous to 部. 3) When 印 is strong, prioritize scriptural study path; when 食伤 is strong, prioritize expressive/ritual performance path. 4) Complete a fixed set of core texts before advanced 法术. 5) Use 36 as a symbolic full cycle for 小周天 or yearly review (one theme per xun or per month set).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-topic scriptures, this is a meta-textual claim about the whole Daozang architecture. It differs from 道藏目录 style cataloguing by asserting salvific power in the number and order of divisions themselves.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that nine true (九真) deities dwell in graded body centers and can be visited through sequential meditation; immortality is progressive interior ascent matching Shangqing heavenly ranks. Mapping gods onto anatomy makes the body a ladder of heavens.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Nine True Ones correspond to nine corporeal stations → 2) Visualization installs/awakens each true god → 3) Each station mastered opens the next rank → 4) Full circuit integrates spirit with Shangqing hierarchy → 5) Integration yields longevity and flight of spirit → 6) Hence graded inner ascent replaces crude longevity drugs.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Correlate nine stations loosely with BaZi structure (year to hour as outer to inner ranks). 2) Practice one center per lunar month; do not leap ranks. 3) Strong 官杀 charts: emphasize disciplined sequence and ritual purity. 4) Weak 印 charts: lengthen time on each station before advancing. 5) Record dreams/omens after each station as feedback of 真 presence.
entries.logic_compare: More systematically multi-deity and ranked than 黄庭's organ poetry; less dual-cultivation than later sexual neidan. It is classic Shangqing: visionary hierarchy first, chemical metaphor second.

entries.logic_thesis: Lingbao's ten-section corpus proves that universal salvation (度人) operates through cosmic liturgy, sacred sound, and shared scriptural merit—not elite solitary ascent alone. The ten divisions encode a complete soteriology for self and others in one ritual-scriptural machine.
entries.logic_chain: 1) All beings share original celestial script/qi → 2) Ritual recitation reactivates that script → 3) Tenfold structure covers creation, judgment, salvation, and return → 4) Merit circulates to ancestors and multitudes → 5) Community ritual multiplies individual power → 6) Therefore Lingbao path is simultaneously personal and collective.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi counseling, balance self-help with ancestral/family luck repair (collective 度人). 2) Use 食伤 (expression) days for recitation and teaching. 3) When 比劫 is heavy, channel into group practice rather than competition. 4) Design ten-module annual practice covering body, speech, mind, ethics, service. 5) Prefer 灵宝-style 斋 for death/transition years over purely personal alchemy.
entries.logic_compare: Contrasts with Shangqing elitism and with pure Neidan solitude: Lingbao is liturgical and universalist. Compared with 度人经 alone, the 十部 claim is architectural—completeness of ten as full salvation toolkit.

entries.logic_thesis: The text demonstrates that Xuan Tian Shang Di's martial power to subdue demons is rooted in filial and cosmic 报恩; true spiritual authority is repayment of debt to parents, teachers, and heaven. Exorcistic might without gratitude collapses into mere violence.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Even the Dark Emperor cultivated under grace of teachers/parents/Dao → 2) Demonic chaos is ingratitude and rebellion writ large → 3) 报恩 rectifies the heart that commands ritual power → 4) Rectified heart + ritual subdues inner and outer demons → 5) Subdued chaos returns order (北帝 justice) → 6) Thus ethics of gratitude is the precondition of martial Daoist efficacy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before 七杀-heavy exorcistic or assertive life moves, perform 报恩 (parents, mentors). 2) In BaZi, when 官杀 is useful, refine it through discipline + gratitude, not raw aggression. 3) Use 壬/癸 and northern sector practices under Xuan Tian for Water-strong charts. 4) Treat chronic 羊刃/七杀 illness patterns as 'unrepaid force'—soften with 印 and filial acts. 5) Annual 报恩 rite at start of 大运 change.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike generic Zhenwu exorcism manuals that list talismans and generals, this jing theologically centers 报恩 as the root. It differs from 洪恩灵济真君妙经 by tying gratitude specifically to the northern martial deity's path of demon-subjugation.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture argues that the Heavenly Lad (天童) force—youthful luminous spirit—can be reawakened by recitation to repel plague, weapons, and evil qi. Spiritual juvenescence is a protective technology: return to pure 童状态 immunizes against corruption.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Primordial spirit is childlike and luminous → 2) Age, fear, and impurity dim that light → 3) 天童 mantra restores luminous youth of spirit → 4) Restored light repels epidemic and malevolent qi → 5) Protection is radiance, not armor alone → 6) Hence rejuvenation of mind-spirit is civil defense of the body.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For charts with exhausted 印 or premature aging signs, prioritize 天童-style light recitation at dawn. 2) Pair with Wood/Fire gentle rising practices (肝魂/心神). 3) Use in 病符 and epidemic-fear years as qi hygiene. 4) Visualize inner child-light in the niwan or heart while walking. 5) Avoid cynical over-analysis immediately after practice—protect 童心.
entries.logic_compare: More protective-rejuvenative than philosophical Daodejing commentaries; less star-focused than 十一曜经. Among Lingbao texts, it specializes in luminous youth as apotropaic principle rather than full 度人 cosmology.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that the 'Heavenly Passes' (天关) are locked gates in body and cosmos that open only via correct diagrams (三图) and sequential passage; without maps, ascent fails even with zeal. Liberation is navigational knowledge as much as virtue or breath.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Spirit travel/ascent faces guarded passes → 2) Three figures encode routes, guardians, and timing → 3) Meditating the diagrams installs the map in the body → 4) Correct approach opens each 关 → 5) Opened passes allow reunion with higher Zhen → 6) Diagram literacy is soteriological skill.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read BaZi 冲刑合害 as 'passes'—plan sequential resolution, not all at once. 2) Draw or study three personal maps: body gates, life phases (大运), and annual obstacles. 3) Strong 食伤: create diagrams and talismanic art as practice. 4) Weak 官杀 structure: need external teacher/map more than self-invention. 5) Before 交运, rehearse the 'next pass' visualization for 49 days.
entries.logic_compare: Emphasizes cartographic revelation more than 九真中经's deity installation or Neidan's fire phases. Among Shangqing works, it is distinctive for 图 as primary technology rather than pure verse or pure breath.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture establishes that lifespan is extendable when the Great Emperor's decree is petitioned through pure recitation and moral reform; years are administrative allotments in a celestial bureaucracy that can be revised. Longevity is juridical-grace as well as physiological.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Destiny boards record allotted lifespan → 2) Sin and waste of jing shorten the register → 3) Confession + 大帝 scripture move celestial officers → 4) Officers amend the life ledger → 5) Amended ledger manifests as health and extra years → 6) Thus 延寿 combines ethics, ritual petition, and conservation of essence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, weak 印 + strong 劫/伤 may signal short-use of resources—pair conservation with 延寿 recitation. 2) Practice on 甲子 and personal 本命日. 3) Combine with sleep, sexual moderation, and breath as 'not contesting the ledger.' 4) For clients in 衰运, prioritize decree-style prayer over aggressive 补药 alone. 5) Track birthdays as annual audit of the life register.
entries.logic_compare: More bureaucratic-celestial than medical 肘后方 or alchemical furnace texts. Differs from generic 消灾 by targeting the life-span register specifically under 大帝 authority rather than broad misfortune.

entries.logic_thesis: The text argues that the Five Saints' nativity discloses how sagehood enters history through patterned birth omens and cosmic timing; sanctity is an emergent alignment of heaven, earth, and human lineage. Studying '始生' reveals the template by which greatness is timed into the world.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Five Saints appear under specific celestial-human conditions → 2) Those conditions encode a birth pattern of virtue and mandate → 3) Recalling their nativity re-syncs community with that pattern → 4) Sync produces moral renewal and protective grace → 5) Individuals can approximate the pattern in their own natal timing → 6) Hagiographic cosmology becomes a science of auspicious emergence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Compare client BaZi to classical 'sage birth' markers (clear 印, useful 官, balanced 调候) without forcing identity. 2) Use 五圣 feast/nativity days for vow renewal. 3) For 日主 weak but 印 strong charts, frame life as 'delayed sage function'—service over status. 4) Study parents/ancestors pillars as the 'womb field' of mandate. 5) Ritual retelling of origin stories as 开运 at career starts.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure technical nativity manuals (子平), it sacralizes birth as theophany of saints. Unlike abstract 太极 cosmogonies, it narrates concrete holy births as operable templates for devotion and timing.

entries.logic_thesis: Qingwei method proves that thunder-fire (雷法) efficacy depends on aligning practitioner's heart-fire with celestial thunder bureaux through secret seals, breaths, and commands; outer talismans fail without inner 神烈. Violent weather-spirits obey only a mind already refined to pure decisive clarity.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Thunder is heaven's punitive/ transformative force → 2) Human heart can mirror thunder if purified → 3) Seals, mudras, and mantras couple heart to thunder officers → 4) Coupled command directs rain, exorcism, healing → 5) Impure intent rebounds as self-harm → 6) Therefore secret method = ethics + precise energetic protocol.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Only train thunder methods if BaZi can support Fire/Wood authority without mania (watch 伤官见官). 2) Daily 心火 purification before any 符. 3) Use 震/巽 days and hours for practice. 4) Channel 七杀 as ordered thunder, not scattered anger. 5) After rituals, ground with Earth/Water to prevent Fire exhaustion.
entries.logic_compare: More martial-operational than Shangqing visionary calm; more lineage-secret than public 消灾 recitation scriptures. Among Lei fa corpora, Qingwei stresses refined heart-fire (神烈) and bureaucratic command over purely shamanic frenzy.

entries.logic_thesis: The scripture demonstrates that eight thearchs (八帝) embody a complete set of cosmic-spiritual essences (妙精); mastering their names, attributes, and invocations reconstitutes the practitioner as a microcosmic pantheon. Dongshen practice is sovereignty through identification with multiple divine wills in order.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Eight Emperors partition cosmic authority → 2) Each holds a mode of 精 (essence/spirit power) → 3) Correct invocation installs that mode in the adept → 4) Integrated eightfold essence yields 洞神 mastery → 5) Mastery grants protection and spirit efficacy → 6) Polycentric deity work completes what single-god devotion leaves partial.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map eight modes onto 八卦/八字 directions for spatial practice. 2) Rotate weekly focus across eight qualities (e.g. severity, mercy, growth, harvest). 3) For missing elemental legs in BaZi, invoke the corresponding Emperor quality as training wheel. 4) Keep a register of dreams under each Emperor. 5) Seal practice by returning authority to the Dao—avoid ego inflation after multi-deity work.
entries.logic_compare: Dongshen 'god multiplicity' differs from Taiqing alchemy's furnace unity and Lingbao's universal salvation liturgy. Compared with 九真, eight emperors are more sovereign-administrative than intimate body-true gods of Shangqing.

entries.logic_thesis: The collected records of Lü Dongbin prove that immortality is a path of repeated testing, teaching, and playful intervention in the world—not withdrawal alone. The perfected person remains an agent of conversion whose biography itself is a didactic logic of trial → awakening → transmission.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Lü's failures and trials precede mastery → 2) Mastery expresses as compassion and sharp teaching → 3) Stories encode alchemical and ethical laws in narrative form → 4) Reader reenacts the trial pattern internally → 5) Reenactment ripens 剑 (discernment) and 丹 (elixir) → 6) Hagiography is a transmission device equal to technical manuals.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use Lü stories as case studies for 食神/伤官 expression in teaching roles. 2) Practice 'one trial, one insight' journaling each week. 3) In weak-will charts, cultivate 呂祖's sword as metaphor for cutting delusion (meditation + decisiveness). 4) Combine drinking/poetry metaphors carefully: spirit of ease without actual dissipation. 5) On 純阳 feast days, renew vows of non-harm and study.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike impersonal heavenly scriptures, 呂祖志 is biographical-narrative theology. It is more worldly and pedagogical than early Shangqing ascent texts, and less systematically staged than Zhong-Lü technical dialogues—though overlapping in Complete Reality culture.

entries.logic_thesis: This Zhengyi text proves that petition slips (章) addressed to correctly ranked officers (官) are the legal mechanism by which heaven corrects illness and injustice; ritual is litigation in the celestial court. Efficacy depends on accurate bureaucracy—right officer, right format, right merit—not vague prayer.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmos runs as an administrative state → 2) Human affliction often = case pending or misfiled → 3) 上章 files the case to named officers → 4) Officers dispatch functionaries to correct qi/demons/records → 5) Correct filing yields medical-social relief → 6) Priestly expertise is celestial paralegal skill.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Diagnose which 'department' a BaZi problem belongs to (wealth, health, lawsuits, ancestors). 2) Prefer Zhengyi petition logic for 官杀 and legal-year issues. 3) Write clear intention statements as if filing 章—specificity increases results. 4) Build merit (good deeds) as court 'standing' before major petitions. 5) After ritual, act in the human court/hospital consistently with the filing.
entries.logic_compare: Sharply more legal-bureaucratic than Neidan's physiological metaphors or Qingwei thunder commands. Distinct from Lingbao communal zhai by focusing on documentary petitions and officer rosters (官品).

entries.logic_thesis: The literary corpus of the Xu immortals shows that refined writing (翰藻) itself is a vehicle of sacred presence; elegant composition, poetry, and revelation texts transmit numinous authority in culture. Cultivation includes mastery of language as talismanic art, not only breath and ritual gesture.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Xu lineage manifests through inspired writings → 2) Beautiful correct language orders chaotic qi in readers → 3) Literary offering maintains the cult and the gods' responsiveness → 4) Practitioner who polishes word polishes mind → 5) Polished mind becomes fit receptacle for further revelation → 6) Therefore letters are a Daoist technology of presence.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For 食伤-strong charts, make writing primary cultivation (poems, petitions, journals). 2) Copy scriptures in regular script as 静心. 3) Edit speech: fewer false words = fewer 口业 chart hits. 4) Compose birthday/祭 texts for ancestors as 翰藻 practice. 5) Treat AI/modern writing tools as brushes—intention still leads form.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike dry code-law 章官品 or anonymous heavenly dictation style, 徐仙翰藻 foregrounds literary aesthetics of a local immortal cult. It bridges literati culture and Daoist revelation more than purely oral thunder or star mantras.

entries.logic_thesis: Ge Hong's emergency formulary proves that true Daoist care includes immediate, practical medicine for crises at hand (肘後); immortality arts without ability to stop acute suffering are incomplete. Knowledge must be portable, tested, and subordinate to saving life in the moment.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Humans face sudden illness and injury → 2) Complex alchemy is useless in acute emergency → 3) Compact proven formulas enable on-the-spot relief → 4) Relieved body becomes capable of further cultivation → 5) Compassion is demonstrated by efficacy, not rhetoric → 6) Thus medical pragmatism is intrinsic to the Daoist path.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Separate BaZi long-term pattern work from acute triage—send crises to medicine first. 2) Build a personal 'elbow kit': sleep, herbs/doctor access, emergency contacts, breath-calming. 3) When 疾厄 is activated, prioritize 备急 over metaphysical speculation. 4) Study classical formulas historically while using modern emergency care as the real 肘後. 5) In counseling ethics, refuse to replace clinical help with talismans alone.
entries.logic_compare: Radically more empirical and clinical than almost all preceding liturgical and alchemical titles in this list. Differs from 抱朴子's broader immortality theory by being a field manual for urgent prescriptions; spirit and herb cooperate, but the genre is medicine first.
